sentences.en: Please remain seated until the aircraft arrives at the gate.
sentences.zh: 请在飞机到达登机门之前保持坐姿。

sentences.en: China has landed their first jet on an aircraft carrier.
sentences.zh: 中国已经在航空母舰上成功降落了第一架喷气式战斗机。

sentences.en: The pilot is battling for the control of the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 飞行员正在为控制飞机而斗争。
